decision.rationale: ORCA is an official UBC centralized assessment service provided by the Office of the Provost and Vice-President, Academic under the Learning Technology Innovation Centre. The public homepage explains assessment facilities and directs instructors and students to practical support. It is not personal, login-only or explicitly Okanagan-exclusive.
evidence: https://orca.ubc.ca/ | 93f75ba04c69de61ff9466ea4570eb27c49203302b6803183293c5d390d86721 | The Open Resource Centre for Assessments (ORCA) aims to solve a key problem in teaching and learning: helping instructors run digital assessments at scale securely and equitably.

https://orca.ubc.ca/ | 93f75ba04c69de61ff9466ea4570eb27c49203302b6803183293c5d390d86721 | The ORCA is a centralized service provided by the Office of the Provost and Vice-President, Academic and sits under LTIC (Learning Technology Innovation Centre).

https://orca.ubc.ca/ | 93f75ba04c69de61ff9466ea4570eb27c49203302b6803183293c5d390d86721 | If you’re interested in learning more about the ORCA, visit our support page for next steps, including weekly drop-in tours, and virtual office hours.

fallback.rationale: ORCA provides practical guidance and services for instructors and students using UBC digital assessment facilities.
